|---|---|---|---|

| `openorienteering/ISSprOM 2019_4000.xmap` | same | same | GPL-3.0 |
| `openorienteering/Course_Design_10000.xmap` | same | same | GPL-3.0 |

The symbol *specifications* themselves are published by the International Orienteering Federation:
ISOM 2017-2, ISSprOM 2019-2 and the International Specification for Control Descriptions (2024).
